text: inside of hmsc-int, when walking down any slope, like a very very mild heightfield to a steep one, or even stair cases, the player model is basically 'falling' if that makes sense. like walking upwards is normal, walking downwards shows like you are just landing from a fall on every step
resolution: Fixed downhill 'falling on every step': framework/game/physics.zig ground resolution only snapped the player UP when below ground, so any descent (mild slope, steep heightfield, stairs) went ballistic each frame — gravity accumulated, then a hard landing, repeated per step. Added a downhill snap: a grounded player whose ground dropped by at most step_height (0.35m default) is glued back to the surface with vy zeroed; bigger drops are real ledges and still fall. Covers editor play view AND compiled game (both run the same Zig step). Two regression tests added (glued 60fps descent; >step ledge still airborne); verified the descent test fails without the fix. Needs a host rebuild — Zig change, hot reload won't pick it up.
